title: Airbnb's strong quarter: 5 key takeaways for investors
description: Airbnb raised its full-year 2026 revenue outlook following a strong Q2 performance. Revenue rose 17% to $3.61 billion, while EPS hit $1.37, beating Wall Street estimates. Robust international travel demand, FIFA World Cup bookings, and AI integration across host tools drove a sharp surge in after-hours stock trading.

title: Samvardhana Motherson shares rally over 7% after Q1 earnings; Motilal Oswal, Nomura weigh in

title: Old strategies buried alive: How CAS hit Dalal Street traders
description: The new closing auction session (CAS) has rattled Dalal Street, with traders saying long-standing strategies are no longer working. SEBI, however, remains confident the system will improve as participation rises. Weak liquidity and volatile closing prices have intensified concerns, forcing traders and brokerages to adapt to the new market mechanism.

title: Global Market: China, Hong Kong stocks rise as strong trade data and AI demand lift sentiment
description: China and Hong Kong equities advanced on Friday after stronger-than-expected July trade data reinforced confidence in the country's export resilience. Robust demand for AI-related technologies, particularly semiconductors, lifted investor sentiment, while Morgan Stanley reiterated its preference for Hong Kong equities amid improving earnings prospects.

title: Crompton Greaves shares crash 7% despite strong Q1 results
description: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals shares fell to a day's low of ₹250 on Friday, even after posting strong Q1 results a day earlier. The company reported a 15.2% YoY jump in PAT to ₹143 crore (6.4% margin) and 11.8% YoY revenue growth to ₹2,235 crore, driven by broad-based performance across segments.

title: Kalyan Jewellers shares jump 5% after Jefferies starts coverage with 'Buy'. More upside after 63% rally in 1 month?
description: Kalyan Jewellers shares witnessed an uptick on Friday  after Jefferies initiated coverage with a Buy rating and Rs 830 target, implying 39% upside. The stock has rallied 63% in a month. Analysts see further gains, citing strong momentum, franchise-led expansion, healthy returns and improving operating performance.

title: Gold prices jump Rs 6,400/10 grams this week, silver soars Rs 11,502/kg amid peace deal optimism. Big rally ahead?
description: Gold and silver prices climbed on the MCX on Friday, extending their recent gains as easing oil prices and expectations around U.S. interest rates supported sentiment. Investors are now awaiting the U.S. nonfarm payrolls report for clues on the Federal Reserve's next policy move, while analysts advise caution ahead of the key data release.

title: Jefferies' Chris Wood sells HDFC Bank, PB Fintech shares to buy 2 new stocks

The move, detailed in his GREED & fear report, signals a shift toward exchange infrastructure and consumer retail plays.

title: Indian bonds buckle under oil spike, fresh debt sale
description: Indian government bonds declined early Friday, reversing some weekly gains. Higher oil prices and global rate fears impacted investor sentiment before a large debt sale. New Delhi plans to raise 320 billion rupees through bond auctions later today. The benchmark Brent crude contract saw a significant price increase since Tuesday. The Reserve Bank of India maintained its repo rate, easing immediate inflation concerns.
